name: Miwasaka Manami
source:
A first-year at the academy.

A talented performer, she joined as the sixth Firefolk.

She’s highly attuned to trends on top of being a fan of tokusatsu and anime.

Prone to strong emotions, it’s always easy to tell what she’s thinking.
She and Souichi are classmates.

Her ability is Kotodama, an advanced form of magic.

She uses MDs like spellbooks to cast spells in battle.

(from Kagura Games' website)
